name: ps1-dev-cart

netyaroze.emulatorPath.markdownDescription: The emulator (PCSX-Redux) for every kind of project (Net Yaroze, PsyQ, PsyQo, PSn00bSDK): **Run**, **Run Linked**, **Run CD Image** and the debugger (e.g. `C:\pcsx-redux\pcsx-redux.exe`; the **Browse...** button of the panel sets it). Net Yaroze makefiles get it as `PCSX_REDUX`. Empty: PCSX-Redux installed by the extension (Tools in the panel) or by PSX.Dev.

netyaroze.wslDistribution.markdownDescription: WSL distribution with the build environment installed. Empty: the default distribution.

netyaroze.toolchainPath.markdownDescription: Where the toolchain is installed in WSL (used to find the SDK headers for IntelliSense).

netyaroze.gdbPath.markdownDescription: GDB in WSL used for debugging (`sudo apt install gdb-multiarch`).

netyaroze.gdbPort.markdownDescription: Port of PCSX-Redux's GDB server while debugging.

netyaroze.mipsToolchainPath.markdownDescription: Folder of the MIPS toolchain for PsyQ / PsyQo / nugget projects (`make`, `mipsel-none-elf-gcc`, `gdb-multiarch`), e.g. the one PSX.Dev installs. Empty: `%APPDATA%\mips\mips\bin` (PSX.Dev), else the PATH.

netyaroze.psn00bsdkPath.markdownDescription: PSn00bSDK folder (the release package, with `bin` and `lib\libpsn00b`) for PSn00bSDK projects (`PSN00BSDK_LIBS` is set from it). Empty: from the `PSN00BSDK_LIBS` environment variable.

netyaroze.cmakePath.markdownDescription: `cmake` for PSn00bSDK projects (CMake, with Ninja). Empty: `C:\Program Files\CMake\bin\cmake.exe` when installed, else `cmake` from the PATH.

netyaroze.ninjaPath.markdownDescription: `ninja` (or its folder) for PSn00bSDK projects. Empty: the one installed by the extension (Tools in the panel), else the PATH.

netyaroze.offerTools.markdownDescription: Offer to install the tools a workspace's projects need (MIPS toolchain, PSn00bSDK, CMake, Ninja...) when it is opened.

netyaroze.windowsGdbPath.markdownDescription: GDB on Windows for debugging PsyQ / PSn00bSDK programs (e.g. PSX.Dev's `gdb-multiarch.exe`). Empty: the one of the MIPS toolchain when there is one, else `gdb-multiarch` in WSL (`netyaroze.gdbPath`).

netyaroze.buildConfiguration.markdownDescription: Build of PsyQ / PSn00bSDK projects: `Debug` (`make BUILD=Debug`, `CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug`: line-by-line debugging) or `Release` (optimised).

netyaroze.ps1transferPath.markdownDescription: Path of `ps1transfer`, the PS1 DEV CART tool. Empty: the one that comes with the extension.

netyaroze.devcartSerial.markdownDescription: USB serial number of the PS1 DEV CART to run and debug on, chosen with **PS1 DEV CART: Select Cart...** (the cartridge button in the status bar; `ps1transfer -l` lists them). Empty: the first one found.

enumDescriptions: printf goes to this computer: the terminal of Run on PS1 (with the PCDRV file server), the Debug Console while debugging.
Serial port TTY driver like the Net Yaroze boot disc: link play over the link cable (printf goes to the serial port).
The same driver over the USB link: link play without a cable (run the game on two consoles, then ps1transfer -relay, or the Link test page of the PS1 Dev Cart Manager).
The BIOS TTY device is kept.
netyaroze.devcartTty.markdownDescription: TTY (printf, `tty:`) of the game on a PS1 DEV CART.

netyaroze.devcartSerial2.markdownDescription: USB serial number of the **second** PS1 DEV CART, for link play on two consoles (**Run Linked on Two PS1s**, **Debug Linked on Two PS1s**): chosen in the PS1 DEV CART panel or with **Net Yaroze: Select Second Cart...**.

enumDescriptions: The consoles are joined by a link cable: the game runs with the serial port TTY driver (like the Net Yaroze boot disc).

No cable: the same driver over the USB link, and ps1transfer's relay joins the two cartridges through this computer (runs in a terminal until closed). Not for debugging (the debuggers use the cartridges).
netyaroze.devcartLink.markdownDescription: How the two consoles of link play are linked (**Run Linked on Two PS1s**, **Debug Linked on Two PS1s**).

netyaroze.ps1usbSerial.markdownDeprecationMessage: Replaced by `netyaroze.devcartSerial` (still used when that one isn't set).

netyaroze.ps1usbTty.markdownDeprecationMessage: Replaced by `netyaroze.devcartTty` (still used when that one isn't set).

netyaroze.pauseInProgramCode.markdownDescription: When **Pause** stops the game outside your code (in the interrupt handler or libps/BIOS code, where there is no source and stepping fails), run on to the next function of your program and stop there.

netyaroze.showStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show Build, Run, Run Linked (projects with a `link` target), Debug and Clean buttons in the status bar.

netyaroze.offerIntelliSense.markdownDescription: Offer to configure IntelliSense when a Net Yaroze project without a C/C++ configuration is opened.
